R2 subset: run_20260912T161228Z, predeclared protocol 799f322. StepUP-P150: doi:10.20383/103.01285. Diagram stages are schematic. Sensor modelling verifies side and pitch and mirrors left-foot columns. 12.7 mm discs at preserved 5 mm pitch. Contact threshold >=2% of frame maximum. Fixed 32 by 32 fractional-overlap subgrid. All loaded frames retained, including zero sparse signal. Aggregate frames into step means, then steps within side, sides within participant and equal-weight participants within condition.

R2 subset: run_20260912T161228Z, predeclared protocol 799f322. StepUP-P150: doi:10.20383/103.01285. Administrative subset, not a powered population sample. W1 is preferred walking speed. Flags Exclude, Incomplete, Standing and Outlier must all be zero. Verify metadata identity, side, finite nonnegative arrays, nonempty footprints and no boundary contact. Order by StartFrame and FootstepID. Never exclude low coverage or zero sparse signal. No new participant recruitment for R2.

All layouts are assumptions, not measured Niva geometry or verified reproductions of published arrays.
